comment: StrB installs the Lys-to-Trp crosslink in the biosynthesis of streptide

reactions.description: StrB installs the Lys-to-Trp crosslink through a C-C bond between the Cβ of Lys and the aromatic C7 of Trp

The strA product, 30mer precursor peptide is acted upon by StrB to install the Lys-to-Trp crosslink. The cross-linked product is then further processed likely involving StrC and proteases, to give the final 9-mer cyclic streptide.
